notes.abs: Net revenue, gross profit, EBITDA and operating expense in US dollars, read from the monthly financial statements. The box above each quarter-end month holds that quarter's three months added together.
notes.pct: Each line is that figure as a share of net revenue in the same month, so no dollar amount is shown. The box above each quarter-end month holds the quarter's own margin — the three months' figures added up, then divided — not the average of the three monthly margins.

t3m_pair.basis: same three calendar months, prior year
